name: PromoForge Smart Campaigns for WooCommerce
author: Hiren Gediya

sections.description:
PromoForge Smart Campaigns for WooCommerce is a powerful WooCommerce discount plugin that lets you create structured Flash Sales, BOGO deals, scheduled offers, and special URL-based promotions — without modifying global pricing rules.

If you are looking for a WooCommerce BOGO plugin, WooCommerce flash sale plugin, or an advanced WooCommerce discount rules system, PromoForge gives you full control over products, categories, timing, and campaign visibility.

Designed for real-world WooCommerce stores, PromoForge ensures discounts are applied correctly on the product page, cart, and checkout — without affecting global pricing rules.

Unlike simple discount plugins that override global pricing, PromoForge applies campaign-based pricing logic only where required.

PromoForge is built for WooCommerce store owners who want structured promotional campaigns — not just basic discounts.

With the Free version, you can easily configure up to 2 active Flash Offer campaigns. Upgrading to the Pro Add-on unlocks unlimited active campaigns, BOGO offers, scheduled events, countdown timers, and advanced reports!

Free vs Pro

  • Flash Offers — Free: 2 active campaigns | Pro: Unlimited campaigns
  • Basic Badge Settings — Free: Yes | Pro: Yes
  • BOGO Offers (Buy One Get One) — Free: No | Pro: Unlimited campaigns
  • Special URL Offers — Free: No | Pro: Yes
  • Upcoming & Scheduled Offers — Free: No | Pro: Yes
  • Countdown Timers — Free: No | Pro: Yes
  • Reports & Analytics Dashboard — Free: No | Pro: Yes
  • Usage Limits Per Customer — Free: No | Pro: Yes

Key Features

  • Flash Offers with category and product targeting (Free: 2 active campaigns)
  • Upcoming Offers with scheduled start and end dates (Pro Feature)
  • Special Offers displayed via shortcode (Pro Feature)
  • BOGO Offers / Buy One Get One / Buy X Get Y (Pro Feature)
  • Offer-specific pricing logic (no global price override)
  • Discounts applied on:
    • Product page
    • Cart page
    • Checkout page
  • AJAX-powered admin interface
  • Shortcode support for flexible placement
  • Secure and optimized architecture
  • Fully compatible with WooCommerce
  • Comprehensive Reports & Analytics dashboard (Pro Feature)

Offer Types

Flash Offers

Create limited-time promotions with automatic expiration and pricing override logic. The Free version allows up to 2 active Flash Offer campaigns simultaneously.

Upcoming Offers (Pro Add-on)

Schedule campaigns to automatically activate and expire at a future date and time. Perfect for seasonal sales preparation.

Special Offers (Pro Add-on)

Create exclusive URL-based offers and display them using shortcodes. Discounts apply only when accessed through the specific offer link.

BOGO Offers (Pro Add-on)

Create Buy One Get One or Buy X Get Y campaigns with quantity-based discount rules applied directly in cart and checkout.

Reports & Analytics (Pro Add-on)

Detailed analytics dashboard to track performance for both Flash and BOGO offers. Includes revenue tracking, order counts, and discount statistics with date range filtering.

How It Works

  1. Create an offer from the WordPress admin dashboard.
  2. Select the offer type (Flash, Upcoming*, Special*, or BOGO*).
  3. Choose products or categories.
  4. Define discount rules.
  5. The offer applies automatically based on configured conditions.
    (*Requires Pro Upgrade)

Global Settings Panel

PromoForge includes a centralized settings panel where store owners can:

  • Customize offer badge texts
  • Control where badges are displayed
  • Configure countdown display formats (Pro Feature)
  • Set BOGO badge labels (Pro Feature)
  • Override product pricing behavior
  • Customize the Thank You page savings message
  • Customize single product display behavior
  • Real-Time License Synchronization: Easily manage active domain allocations for your premium addon.

Perfect For

  • WooCommerce store owners running flash sales
  • Stores offering BOGO promotions
  • Marketing campaigns with limited-time discounts
  • Seasonal or scheduled promotional events

Why Choose PromoForge?

Unlike basic WooCommerce discount plugins that override global pricing, PromoForge applies campaign-based pricing logic only where required. This ensures accurate discount calculations on product pages, cart, and checkout — without interfering with regular pricing rules.

PromoForge is ideal for store owners who want advanced WooCommerce discount rules with structured campaign management.

Compatibility

  • WordPress 5.8+
  • WooCommerce 7.0+
  • PHP 7.4+
  • Supports simple and variable products
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/promoforge-smart-campaigns-for-woocommerce directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. If you have a Pro version, upload and activate the Pro Add-on ZIP file, then enter your license key under the Settings page to unlock advanced features.
sections.faq:
Does this work with variable products?

Yes. The plugin fully supports both simple and variable WooCommerce products.

Does the discount apply globally to all products?

No. Discounts are applied only to products assigned to a specific offer. Global WooCommerce pricing remains unchanged.

Can I schedule offers for future dates?

Yes. By upgrading to the Pro add-on, you can create Upcoming Offers with scheduled start and end dates.

Does it support Buy One Get One (BOGO)?

Yes. BOGO Offers (Buy One Get One / Buy X Get Y) are supported via the Premium Pro add-on.

Will discounts appear on the product page, cart, and checkout?

Yes. Offer discounts are visible and applied on the product page, cart page, and checkout page.

Does it affect WooCommerce performance?

No. The plugin is optimized and built using WordPress best practices to ensure strong performance.

Can I display special offers using a shortcode?

Yes. Special URL-based Offers can be displayed anywhere using shortcodes (Pro Add-on feature).

Is this compatible with the latest WooCommerce version?

Yes. The plugin is regularly tested with the latest WooCommerce version.

  • Updated: Stable version to 1.0.2.
